div.div: جِبًا Water collected (T, S, K) in a trough, (T, K,) being drawn from a well, (T, TA,) for camels; (S;) [like جَبًا;] as also ↓ جِبْوَةٌ , (K, TA, and so in a copy of the S, but omitted in the CK,) or ↓ جَبْوَةٌ , (so in two copies of the S,) and ↓ جُبْوَةٌ also, (so in a copy of the S, [see جَبًا,]) and ↓ جَبَاوَةٌ , (K, TA, and so in a copy of the S,) and ↓ جَبَاوَةٌ , (K, TA, and so in another copy of the S, but omitted in the CK,) and ↓ جِبَآءَةٌ : (TA as from the K, but not in the CK: [perhaps a mistranscription for ↓ جِبَايَةٌ :]) but accord. to IAmb, جِبًا is pl. of ↓ جِبْيَةٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
